smoke-keyboard.measurementNote: Immediate stepsAtResume=0 was a stale UI snapshot. The later check waits for resumed metrics and verifies retained/restored progress.

groupingAnalysis.note: Analytical eight-unit-reward stream with discount 0.9 and lambda 1; an explanatory stress case, not live task results. Cumulative OCR does not reveal within-interval reward times.

interpretation: Paired descriptive engineering trials. Sparse controls and short sweeps do not establish mastery or statistical significance. Error reductions are favorable; accuracy/success increases are favorable.

lifecycle-missing.status: Reward detection was lost. Inputs released and RL progress saved.

limitations: These short live trials do not demonstrate broad learning superiority, faster learning, or reliable conditional mastery of keyboard, click, drag, and scroll controls.
Original keyboard prelude discarded key-down edges before the first cue. Corrected-fixture frozen re-evaluations are reported separately and do not replace the primary measurements.

The original drag fixture allowed repeat pickup reward and retained picked state across invalid releases. Drag learning scores cannot establish valid held dragging. The corrected contract was checked using scripted HID, not a learned policy.

The common primary harness did not record a cumulative admitted-action total or separate packing/transfer CPU timers. Optimizer state, independent received-event exposures, exclusions and inference/vision latency were recorded. No kernel or snapshot-transfer speedup is claimed.
Actual wall-clock scheduling and OCR timing are not deterministic even with identical initial tensors and seeded fixture schedules.

metricDefinitions.accuracy: correct cue seconds / observed cue seconds; a successful keyboard trial only requires some correct occupancy, not a complete sustained hold
metricDefinitions.error: mean Euclidean error in normalized canvas coordinates, separately for each cued phase

keyboardKinds.2: fresh Space edges and exclusive occupancy

metricDefinitions.performance: means of one-second dashboard snapshots after the first five; reported p95 means are not whole-run latency percentiles

pointerKinds.2: drag; original learning fixture has a known invalid-release/pickup-reward defect

metricDefinitions.spaceEdgePrecision: rewarded fresh Space edges / all received Space key-down edges
metricDefinitions.success: successful trials / exposures; absent exposure is missing, not zero success
metricDefinitions.trainingOutcomes: independent fixture counters summed over complete training episodes; interrupted episode counters are separate
